instruction.text: Select a broccoli to find out what this pictogram tells us.

feedback.end: Zak is growing vegetables in his garden. This pictogram shows how many of each kind of vegetable are growing in his garden.

instruction.text: How many pumpkins are growing in the garden?

instruction.text: Order the vegetables from those that are growing the most to those that are growing the least.
